hooks.command: sh -c 'top=$(git -C "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null) && base=$(git -C "$top" config --get review-slices.base) || exit 0; code=$(git -C "$top" show "refs/remotes/$base:.githooks/agent_hook.py" 2>/dev/null) || code=$(cat "$top/.githooks/agent_hook.py" 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; export REVIEW_SLICES_TOP="$top"; exec python3 -I -S -c "$code"' || true
